text:
Laura (Partnerships): Hey team — Vanguard HSM gave us final KMS integration docs. Want to run through launch checklist for marketplace + joint announcement. Timeline: target embargo 2024-05-10. Who's got bandwidth to sanity-check SAML/SCIM mapping and key rotation flows?
Sam (Legal): I need the exact wording for the joint press release and the embargo window. Also any NDAs?
Laura (Partnerships): Vanguard confirmed public launch but asks for a 48h embargo on joint release. NDA already in partner drive. I'll paste the PR draft in a follow-up.
Kevin (Infra): I'll validate KMS flows and HSM key wrapping. Quick Q: do we support vendor-managed HSM or customer-managed keys in this integration?
Nina (Security): We support both patterns but need explicit OK on KMS CMKs in the marketplace UI. Also need key rotation policy and remote attestation docs from Vanguard.
Marcus (Marketplace PM): Marketplace listing needs SKU, pricing tier, and a one-line summary for the catalog. Also screenshots of the onboarding flow.
Laura (Partnerships): Vanguard will provide a vendor logo (svg), SAML metadata endpoint, SCIM base URL and an HSM attestation bundle. Sharing now: SAML metadata: https://vanguard.example.com/saml/metadata
Sam (Legal): Thanks — hold off public copy until I review the embargo clauses. I'll reply by EOD.
Kevin (Infra): Picking this up — I'll run the KMS integration checklist: 
```
- verify encrypt/decrypt via wrapped keys
- confirm Sign/Verify on HSM
- test key rotation (30d)
- validate key policy attachments
```
Nina (Security): Add: run attestation + firmware version check. We'll want a quick smoke test for failing over to software KMS if HSM not available.
Marcus (Marketplace PM): For listing, do we put this under "Hardware & Security" or "Integrations"? Suggest Hardware + an "integrates with Redwood KMS" badge.
Laura (Partnerships): Also need partner enablement doc for SIs: step-by-step SCIM attribute mapping (email -> userPrincipalName, groups -> memberOf), sample SAML assertion with roles claim. Marcus, can you add a link to the SI guide in the listing?
Marcus (Marketplace PM): Yep. I'll create a short "SI onboarding" asset in the docs site and link it. ETA tomorrow.
Deploy Bot: deploy-notification: marketplace-draft created - env: staging - build 1.42.3 :rocket:
Laura (Partnerships): Next action items: Kevin + Nina run integration tests by Tue 5pm, Sam to clear PR language by Tue noon, Marcus to draft listing by Wed. I'll coordinate a partner rehearsal call Wed 10am PT.
Sam (Legal): Ack.
Kevin (Infra): Ack, creating tickets.
Nina (Security): Ack.
Laura (Partnerships): Thanks all — tagging @Vanguard contacts for awareness: @vanguard-eng. :thumbsup:
